title: Nausea
author: Jean-Paul Sartre
summary: Antoine Roquentin, a historian living in a French port town, keeps a diary of a growing sense of disgust at the sheer existence of objects and people. It is Sartre's novel of existentialism.
readIf: you want an early existentialist novel and enjoy introspective, plotless narrators.
skipIf: you want a conventional story with events and resolution.
